notes: Model files are never stored in this repository. Each file is downloaded on first use from a URL pinned to a commit or release and verified with SHA-256. Licenses were checked at the cited source on the verification date.

models.name: D-FINE S (Objects365 → COCO)

license.notes: The ONNX conversion repository has no license field; it inherits Apache-2.0 from the base checkpoint (ustc-community, authors of D-FINE).

models.io: pixel_values float32 [N,3,640,640] (RGB 0..1, no normalization) -> logits [N,300,80], pred_boxes [N,300,4] cxcywh normalized; opset 16
models.notes: fp32. The fp16 variant is not used: ONNX Runtime CUDA has no fp16 GridSample (note N3). Parity verified against our own export (tools/lab/export_dfine.py).

license.notes: The ONNX conversion repository has no license field; it inherits Apache-2.0 from the base checkpoint.

models.name: InsightFace buffalo_l

license.notes: Models are for non-commercial research purposes only. Never bundled; downloaded on first use only after explicit acceptance (CLAUDE.md §6, P11).

models.io: det_10g: SCRFD detection with 5 keypoints; 2d106det: 106 landmarks (eye openness, spec §6); w600k_r50: 512-d face embedding.
models.notes: SHA-256 is the official GitHub release asset digest.

models.name: YuNet face detector (OpenCV Zoo)

license.notes: MIT, not Apache-2.0 as previously listed in spec §15 (corrected 2026-10-12).

models.io: input [1,3,640,640] fixed shape (letterbox required, note N4); outputs cls/obj/bbox/kps at strides 8/16/32; 5 keypoints only.
models.notes: With YuNet/SFace eyes are always 'unknown' (decision A5).

models.name: SFace face recognizer (OpenCV Zoo)
models.io: input 'data' [1,3,112,112] (weights are also listed as graph inputs: feed only 'data'); output fc1 [1,128].

models.name: CLIP ViT-B/32

license.notes: Note N1: the OpenAI model card (https://huggingface.co/openai/clip-vit-base-patch32) states that any deployed use case is currently out of scope. This is usage guidance, not a license term; to be evaluated in phase 2 (OpenCLIP alternatives).

models.io: vision: pixel_values [N,3,224,224] (shortest edge 224 bicubic, center crop, CLIP mean/std) -> image_embeds [N,512]; text: input_ids int64 [N,L] -> text_embeds [N,512].
models.notes: fp32 (decision F2-1, 13 Oct 2026): the dynamically quantized conversion fails parity with the original openai/clip-vit-base-patch32 (image embedding cosine 0.87-0.97 on 40 real photos) and does not accelerate on GPU; fp32 matches it (cosine 1.000000 on CPU and CUDA, text embeddings too). Quantized pair ≈ 153 MB (spec §5).

models.name: RAM++ Swin-L (ONNX, fp32)

license.notes: Upstream code xinyu1205/recognize-anything and weights xinyu1205/recognize-anything-plus-model are Apache-2.0. Mirror: imagent/ram-plus-onnx (unchanged copy).

models.io: input [1,3,384,384] fixed (Pillow bilinear squash resize, ImageNet mean/std) -> output [1,4585] logits (sigmoid, then per-tag thresholds).
models.notes: Decision F3-1 (13 Oct 2026): same tag sets as the original PyTorch RAM++ on 52/52 local photos (tools/lab/verify_ramplus.py); C# adapter parity: identical probabilities on CPU, max 1.7e-6 on CUDA (RamPlusParityTests). The int8 conversion is no longer used (12/52 identical sets).

models.name: PaddleOCR (RapidOCR ONNX): PP-OCRv4 detection + PP-OCRv3 English recognition

license.notes: PaddleOCR models (Apache-2.0) converted to ONNX by RapidOCR (Apache-2.0); the recognition dictionary is in the model metadata ('character').

models.io: det x [1,3,H,W] (multiples of 32, min side 736, (x/255-0.5)/0.5) -> probability map [1,1,H,W]; rec x [1,3,48,W<=320] -> softmax [1,T,97] (blank + 96 characters).
models.notes: Decision F4-1 (13 Oct 2026): C# adapters with antialiased resizing and simple DB post-processing; parity with tools/lab/ocr_refs.py on 25 real photos: identical inputs, maps, boxes and texts (OcrParityTests).

models.name: Florence-2 base-ft: our vision encoder export + onnx-community text encoder and decoder
models.version: microsoft/Florence-2-base-ft weights; onnx-community@e88a44e; vision export pf-1

license.notes: Florence-2 (MIT, Microsoft). Text encoder, decoder and tokenizer from the onnx-community conversion (MIT); the vision encoder is exported by tools/lab/export_florence_vision.py from florence-community/Florence-2-base-ft@0b03b6f (MIT) because the onnx-community one does not match the original model.

models.io: vision pixel_values [1,3,768,768] (bicubic, ImageNet mean/std) -> image_features [1,577,768]; embed_tokens input_ids -> [B,L,768]; encoder (attention_mask, inputs_embeds [1,577+13,768]) -> last_hidden_state; decoder_model_merged with past_key_values.* and use_cache_branch -> logits [B,1,51289].
models.notes: Decision F5-1 (13 Oct 2026): task <DETAILED_CAPTION>, beam search 3 as transformers' generate; parity with the original PyTorch model (tools/lab/florence_refs.py) on 24 real photos: identical token ids and captions on CPU and CUDA (CaptionParityTests). The vision encoder file is published as a GitHub release asset of this repository (models-florence2-base-ft-1).
